style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Retrofuturism. Cream paper, burnt orange, petrol teal, space-age technical diagrams. Content occupies at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10–15% at edges.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 全球经营雷达：平台费用、语音AI与供应链
zh-CN.headlineView: 把政策、技术与中断风险放入同一张经营地图
zh-CN.intro: 今日聚焦eBay法意费用、微软语音模型、行业软件认证、印尼火山停航、德国州选举、OPEC+供应预期、黎巴嫩安全与欧洲商业航天。区分已确认进展与初步消息，优先处理影响客户交付的变化。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 把新闻放进同一张经营地图。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先找今天最影响交付的一条。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 全球经营雷达：平台费用、语音AI与供应链；把政策、技术与中断风险放入同一张经营地图

en-US.headlineFact: Global operating radar: marketplace fees, speech AI and supply chains
en-US.headlineView: Put policy, technology and disruption on one operating map
en-US.intro: Today connects eBay fees, Microsoft speech AI, industry certification, Indonesian flights, German elections, oil supply, Lebanon and European spaceflight. Separate confirmed developments from preliminary reports and prioritize changes affecting customer delivery.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Put the news on one operating map.
en-US.doudouQuote: Start with the signal that most affects delivery.
en-US.headlineFull: Global operating radar: marketplace fees, speech AI and supply chains; Put policy, technology and disruption on one operating map

zh-CN.headlineFact: eBay法意费用结构调整，买家保护费计入展示价格
zh-CN.headlineView: 账户身份、买家总价与转化率需要一起重算
zh-CN.intro: eBay说明，自9月1日起，法国和意大利注册私人卖家的商品适用买家保护费，展示价格包含该费用；其他卖家规则不同。跨境经营者应按注册地、私人或专业身份核对规则，不把私人卖家优惠套用到商业账户。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 零卖家费不等于零交易成本。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先核对账户身份，再算买家到手价。
zh-CN.headlineFull: eBay法意费用结构调整，买家保护费计入展示价格；账户身份、买家总价与转化率需要一起重算

en-US.headlineFact: eBay changes French and Italian fee structures with buyer protection included in displayed prices
en-US.headlineView: Recheck account status, buyer totals and conversion together
en-US.intro: eBay says private sellers registered in France or Italy have a buyer protection fee included in displayed listing prices from September 1. Other sellers follow different rules. Operators should check registration and private versus professional status before applying these changes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Zero seller fees do not mean zero transaction costs.
en-US.doudouQuote: Check account status before calculating the buyer total.
en-US.headlineFull: eBay changes French and Italian fee structures with buyer protection included in displayed prices; Recheck account status, buyer totals and conversion together

sources.title: Buyer protection fee information for sellers

zh-CN.headlineFact: 微软MAI-Transcribe-2开放预览，支持60种语言与说话人分离
zh-CN.headlineView: 转写采购应看真实音频质量、可追溯性与流程集成
zh-CN.intro: 微软9月3日宣布MAI-Transcribe-2在Foundry公开预览，加入说话人分离、逐词时间戳及行业关键词偏置。团队可用于会议、字幕和客服记录，但应先用真实口音、噪声与专业术语验证输出，再接入后续自动化。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 转写价值在可检索、可追溯。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 用真实口音和行业术语做小样本验收。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 微软MAI-Transcribe-2开放预览，支持60种语言与说话人分离；转写采购应看真实音频质量、可追溯性与流程集成
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Microsoft previews MAI-Transcribe-2 with 60 languages and speaker diarization
en-US.headlineView: Evaluate transcription on real audio, traceability and integration
en-US.intro: Microsoft announced MAI-Transcribe-2 in Foundry public preview on September 3. It supports 60 languages, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps and keyword biasing. Teams should test real accents, noise and specialist vocabulary before connecting transcripts to automated workflows.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transcripts become valuable when searchable and traceable.
en-US.doudouQuote: Test a small sample with real accents and domain terms.
en-US.headlineFull: Microsoft previews MAI-Transcribe-2 with 60 languages and speaker diarization; Evaluate transcription on real audio, traceability and integration

zh-CN.headlineFact: Quandri入选Applied首批认证厂商，行业AI接入既有软件生态
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司可借鉴窄场景、强集成与可信交付的进入路径
zh-CN.intro: 保险AI平台Quandri于9月1日宣布成为Applied新供应商认证计划首批成员。对一人公司而言，这是一项行业观察：优先解决客户已有软件里的重复工作，验证接口和结果后再扩展；Quandri本身并非一人公司。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 小团队先进入客户已有工作流。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 选一个重复痛点，把接口和结果做扎实。
zh-CN.headlineFull: Quandri入选Applied首批认证厂商，行业AI接入既有软件生态；一人公司可借鉴窄场景、强集成与可信交付的进入路径
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Quandri joins Applied’s inaugural certified vendors, connecting industry AI to established software
en-US.headlineView: Solo founders can learn from narrow use cases, integration and dependable delivery
en-US.intro: Insurance AI platform Quandri announced on September 1 that it joined Applied’s inaugural Vendor Certification Program. Solo founders can learn to solve repeated work inside software customers already use, validate integration and outcomes, then expand. Quandri itself is not a one-person company.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Small teams should enter workflows customers already use.
en-US.doudouQuote: Choose one repeated pain point and make delivery dependable.
en-US.headlineFull: Quandri joins Applied’s inaugural certified vendors, connecting industry AI to established software; Solo founders can learn from narrow use cases, integration and dependable delivery

sources.title: Quandri Named Inaugural Member of Applied Systems Vendor Certification Program

zh-CN.headlineFact: 阿纳克喀拉喀托火山喷发，印尼多地航班受影响
zh-CN.headlineView: 停航会沿机组、货运与客户交付链条传播
zh-CN.intro: 印尼阿纳克喀拉喀托火山喷发后，火山灰影响雅加达等地航空运行。物流与出行团队应核对机场和航司通知，同步更新货期、改签和客户沟通，并评估飞机轮转造成的后续延误。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一次停航会沿机组和货运网络传播。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 同时更新改签、货期与客户通知。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 阿纳克喀拉喀托火山喷发，印尼多地航班受影响；停航会沿机组、货运与客户交付链条传播

en-US.headlineFact: Anak Krakatau eruption disrupts flights across parts of Indonesia
en-US.headlineView: Flight disruption spreads through crews, cargo and customer commitments
en-US.intro: Ash from Indonesia’s Anak Krakatau volcano disrupted flights serving Jakarta and other locations. Logistics and travel teams should check airport and airline notices, update cargo timelines and rebooking plans, and prepare for continuing delays through aircraft rotations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: One shutdown can propagate across crews and cargo networks.
en-US.doudouQuote: Update rebooking, delivery dates and customer notices together.
en-US.headlineFull: Anak Krakatau eruption disrupts flights across parts of Indonesia; Flight disruption spreads through crews, cargo and customer commitments

sources.title: Batam airport cancels five flights amid Anak Krakatau eruption

zh-CN.headlineFact: 出口民调显示AfD领跑德国萨克森-安哈尔特州选举
zh-CN.headlineView: 选票领先与组阁结果必须分开判断
zh-CN.intro: 9月6日州选举出口民调显示，德国选择党在萨克森-安哈尔特州领先；席位与组阁仍需后续确认。关注欧洲市场的经营者应跟踪联盟谈判和具体政策文本，不把初步民调当作已经生效的政策变化。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 先区分选票领先与组阁结果。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 跟踪联盟与政策，不把民调当最终法案。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 出口民调显示AfD领跑德国萨克森-安哈尔特州选举；选票领先与组阁结果必须分开判断

en-US.headlineFact: Exit polls indicate an AfD lead in Germany’s Saxony-Anhalt election
en-US.headlineView: Distinguish a vote lead from the eventual government
en-US.intro: Exit polls for the September 6 state election indicate an AfD lead in Saxony-Anhalt. Seat allocations and government formation need subsequent confirmation. Businesses should track coalition talks and concrete policies instead of treating early projections as enacted changes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Separate a vote lead from government formation.
en-US.doudouQuote: Follow coalitions and policy rather than treating polls as law.
en-US.headlineFull: Exit polls indicate an AfD lead in Germany’s Saxony-Anhalt election; Distinguish a vote lead from the eventual government

sources.title: AfD Tops 44% in Saxony-Anhalt as Majority Hinges on 5% Threshold

zh-CN.headlineFact: OPEC+会议牵动十月供应预期，会前消息指向政策不变
zh-CN.headlineView: 会前消息与正式结果、运输风险需要分别评估
zh-CN.intro: 路透社9月6日援引知情人士称，OPEC+预计在当天会议维持十月产量政策不变，后续调整仍涉及新配额讨论。该说法属于会前消息；企业应等待正式结果，并把燃料成本与运输中断同时纳入情景预算。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 供应预期还要与运输风险一起看。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 燃料与交期同时做情景预算。
zh-CN.headlineFull: OPEC+会议牵动十月供应预期，会前消息指向政策不变；会前消息与正式结果、运输风险需要分别评估

en-US.headlineFact: OPEC+ talks shape October supply expectations as pre-meeting reports point to unchanged policy
en-US.headlineView: Assess preliminary reports separately from decisions and transport risk
en-US.intro: Reuters cited sources on September 6 saying OPEC+ was expected to leave October output policy unchanged while new quotas remained under discussion. This is a pre-meeting report, not a confirmed final decision. Operators should track the outcome and budget fuel alongside transport disruption.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Read supply expectations alongside transport risk.
en-US.doudouQuote: Build scenarios for fuel costs and delivery times together.
en-US.headlineFull: OPEC+ talks shape October supply expectations as pre-meeting reports point to unchanged policy; Assess preliminary reports separately from decisions and transport risk

sources.title: OPEC+ set to maintain oil output policy unchanged at Sunday meeting

zh-CN.headlineFact: 黎巴嫩卫生部门称南部空袭造成4人死亡
zh-CN.headlineView: 区域团队应核对人员联络和业务连续性安排
zh-CN.intro: 据路透社9月6日报道，黎巴嫩卫生部门称南部空袭造成4人死亡；以军称其行动回应无人机袭击。现场信息仍可能更新，相关机构应核对人员状态、紧急联系人、集合点与替代工作地点。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 人员安全与持续运营要同时准备。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 核对联系人、集合点和撤离路线。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 黎巴嫩卫生部门称南部空袭造成4人死亡；区域团队应核对人员联络和业务连续性安排

en-US.headlineFact: Lebanon’s health ministry reports four deaths in southern air strikes
en-US.headlineView: Regional teams should review contacts and business continuity
en-US.intro: Reuters reported on September 6 that Lebanon’s health ministry said four people died in southern air strikes; Israel said it was responding to drone attacks. Organizations should verify staff status, emergency contacts, meeting points and alternate workplaces as details develop.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Prepare for staff safety and continuity together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Verify contacts, meeting points and evacuation routes.
en-US.headlineFull: Lebanon’s health ministry reports four deaths in southern air strikes; Regional teams should review contacts and business continuity

sources.title: Four killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon

zh-CN.headlineFact: Spectrum第二次飞行成功入轨，欧洲商业航天取得新进展
zh-CN.headlineView: 入轨之后仍要观察可靠性、发射节奏与规模化交付
zh-CN.intro: Isar Aerospace的Spectrum火箭9月5日从挪威Andøya发射，第二次飞行成功入轨并部署载荷。欧洲机构将其视为自主进入太空的重要进展；商业客户接下来仍需观察重复发射能力、任务适配与履约周期。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 首个成功之后要看可靠性与发射节奏。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把里程碑与规模化交付分开评估。
zh-CN.headlineFull: Spectrum第二次飞行成功入轨，欧洲商业航天取得新进展；入轨之后仍要观察可靠性、发射节奏与规模化交付

en-US.headlineFact: Spectrum reaches orbit on its second flight in a European commercial space milestone
en-US.headlineView: Follow success with reliability, launch cadence and delivery evidence
en-US.intro: Isar Aerospace launched Spectrum from Andøya, Norway on September 5 and reached orbit with payload deployment on its second flight. European institutions call it a milestone for access to space. Customers still need evidence on repeatability, mission fit and delivery cadence.
en-US.xiaziQuote: After the first success, watch reliability and cadence.
en-US.doudouQuote: Evaluate the milestone and scalable delivery separately.
en-US.headlineFull: Spectrum reaches orbit on its second flight in a European commercial space milestone; Follow success with reliability, launch cadence and delivery evidence
